rows.grounds: causative optative third singular of bhū

items.question: How must the eightfold year be contemplated after the pores are filled?
premises: the object is the eightfold year
items.inference: The verse prescribes contemplating the eightfold year with an undistracted mind.
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of vatsarāṣṭrakam is not specified here
items.plain_english: With an undistracted mind indeed one should contemplate the eightfold year.
